notes:
EKCL has a single non-original workbook: "EKCL_Loan_1st Restructured_Dec'25.xlsx" (an IDCOL-only facility, no co-financier tranche found). It contains one restructure event, effective 2025-12-15, labeled internally in the workbook as "Tenor Extension 1st Restructuring" (cell AI29 of sheet EKCL_BDT_Loan).

Key findings:
- Rate unchanged at 5% before and after (so classified RESTRUCTURE, not RATE_CHANGE, since the tenor/amortization changed).
- Tenor extended from 96 months to 111 months (a 15-month / 5-quarter extension: last contractual payment moved from 2030-12-15 to 2032-03-15), consistent with the "Tenor Extension" label in the workbook.
- The workbook's "Summary" sheet shows the borrower fell materially behind on principal payments between 2024-2025 (large lump-sum catch-up payments of BDT 63.1M, 20M, 15M etc. on irregular dates, vs. small/zero payments in many quarters), while interest was kept current (cumulative "interest due" = cumulative "interest received" throughout, and "Interest overdue" row is 0 in every period). This means the restructuring rolled in overdue/unpaid PRINCIPAL (not capitalized interest) into the new opening balance.
- Quantified overdueAmountRolledIn ≈ BDT 49,340,848.42 — computed as the difference between (a) the contractual closing balance if the 2025-09-15 installment's scheduled principal (BDT 20,300,291.32) had actually been paid down from the prior contractual opening balance (BDT 510,411,817.66), i.e. BDT 490,111,526.33, versus (b) the actual re-based opening balance carried into the restructured schedule at 2025-12-15, BDT 539,452,374.75. No waiver (forgiveness) was found — all figures reconcile as either paid, overdue-and-rolled-forward, or now being re-amortized; waivedAmount = 0.
- capitalizedAmount = 0: no separate interest-capitalization event is evidenced (LPC/other fee amounts of BDT 24,642 and 81,921 appear as small paid fee line items in the Summary sheet, not capitalized into principal).
- No explicit regulatory reference (e.g., "DFIM Circular", "BB approval") was found anywhere in the workbook text across all 5 sheets (Disbursement, Summary, EKCL_BDT_Loan, Accrual_EKCL, Repayment Schedule) — set to null.
- The "params" object uses the OVERRIDE-array approach (interest_payment_amounts / opening_balance_amounts / closing_balance_amounts), matching the pattern used for MCML/QPSL/SCBL/SKS/THERMAX in examples.ts, because the post-restructure schedule includes two interest-only stub periods (2025-12-15 and 2026-03-15, likely a residual moratorium/grace tail) before level-total-debt-service PPMT-style amortization resumes from 2026-06-15 onward — this could not be cleanly reproduced from first principles with a single set of grace-period parameters, so every row is pinned to the workbook's actual values. All 26 override-array rows were verified to chain consistently (each row's opening balance equals the prior row's closing balance) and to fully amortize to a final closing balance of exactly 0, and the sum of implied principal payments (opening minus closing per row) exactly equals the initial opening balance of BDT 539,452,374.75 — high confidence in the override values.
- disbursements is modeled as a single synthetic disbursement of BDT 539,452,374.7495923 on the effective date (serial 46006 = 2025-12-15), representing the rolled-forward opening balance, per the task's stated convention.
- principal_type set to "PPMT Principal" (matching the original EKCL EX_DATA entry's convention) because the total-debt-service-per-period pattern is level (~BDT 26,156,237.43 per quarter for most of the schedule) with principal derived as the plug — the same PPMT-style structure as the original loan, just re-based and re-amortized over a longer remaining tenor.
- day_count_basis (360) and payment_frequency (4, quarterly) carried forward unchanged from the original, consistent with the workbook's own header cells ("Interest calculation 360 days basis", quarterly repayment dates).
- Only one workbook was provided/found for EKCL under the given directory (EKCL_Loan.xlsx is the ORIGINAL and was excluded per instructions; no 2nd/3rd restructure or separate co-financier tranche files exist), so exactly one facility/version entry is produced.
